_comment: Verbatim /printer/objects/query?multi_color_controller from a QIDI Q2 with one QIDI BOX attached, 2026-08-14. All four physical slots loaded, slot0 also loaded to the toolhead. Note slot4..slot15 are reported regardless of how many boxes are attached — they are padding, not slots, which is why tray count must not be derived from the number of keys here.
